title: Comparison pullbacks of injective left-module sheaves are acyclic for arbitrary rings
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $\Lambda$ a discrete associative unital ring, not assumed commutative, in the coefficient universe. Use the small étale and pro-étale sites [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] in a common larger universe in which their underlying categories are small. A $\Lambda$-module sheaf means a sheaf of left $\Lambda$-modules; equivalently it is a sheaf of modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] over the constant sheaf of rings, the sheafification of the constant ring presheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Let $
u_X:X_{\mathrm{proét}}	o X_{\mathrm{ét}}$ be the comparison geometric morphism [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism]. On module sheaves, $
u_X^*$ applies its set inverse image to addition, zero, negation and each scalar endomorphism of the underlying abelian sheaf; $
u_{X,*}$ is restriction to the étale subsite, with its induced scalar actions. Compute $R^q
u_{X,*}$ by injective resolutions in these module categories [def-sp-left-exact-additive, def-sp-injective-resolutions]. Then for every injective left $\Lambda$-module sheaf $I$ on $X_{\mathrm{ét}}$ and every integer $q>0$,
$$
R^q
u_{X,*}(
u_X^*I)=0.
$$
No affineness, quasi-compactness, torsion or finite-ring hypothesis is imposed.
